title: 每日开口 第06课 · 聊GTA6与游戏平台

lines.en: Hey, have you seen the latest GTA 6 news?
lines.zh: 嘿，你看到 GTA 6 的最新消息了吗？

lines.en: Yeah! I'm so excited. Are you planning to pick it up at launch?
lines.zh: 看了！我太兴奋了。你打算发售时就买吗？

lines.en: Honestly, I'm holding out for the PC version.
lines.zh: 说实话，我在等 PC 版。

lines.en: Oh, so it's console only for now?
lines.zh: 哦，所以目前只有主机版？

lines.en: As far as I know, it's coming out on PS5 and Xbox first. PC usually comes later.
lines.zh: 据我所知先出 PS5 和 Xbox，PC 通常晚一些。

lines.en: That's a long wait. Why not just buy a console?
lines.zh: 那要等很久。干嘛不直接买台主机？

lines.en: I'd rather wait than buy a console just for one game.
lines.zh: 我宁可等，也不想为一个游戏买主机。

lines.en: Fair enough. I'll be playing it on my PS5 on day one, though.
lines.zh: 有道理。不过我发售当天就在 PS5 上玩。

lines.en: Lucky you. Is it worth buying at full price?
For GTA, definitely. It's worth the wait, and it's worth paying for.
lines.zh: GTA 的话绝对值得，值得等，也值得花钱。

lines.en: If it comes to PC, I'll buy it straight away.
lines.zh: 如果出 PC 版，我马上买。

lines.en: Do you think your laptop could run it?
lines.zh: 你觉得你的笔记本带得动吗？

lines.en: Probably not. I might have to upgrade my graphics card.
lines.zh: 大概不行。我可能得升级显卡。

lines.en: Well, by then the PC port should be out, and I'll have finished the story.
lines.zh: 到那时 PC 移植版应该出了，我也通关剧情了。

lines.en: Please don't spoil it for me!
I won't. Promise. Let me know when it comes out on PC.
lines.zh: 不会的，保证。PC 版出来告诉我。

lines.en: By the way, do you play on a controller or with a keyboard and mouse?
lines.zh: 顺便问一下，你用手柄还是键盘鼠标玩？

lines.en: Keyboard and mouse for shooters, but a controller for driving games.
lines.zh: 射击游戏用键盘鼠标，开车游戏用手柄。

lines.en: That makes sense. Racing on a keyboard is painful.
lines.zh: 有道理。用键盘玩赛车很痛苦。

lines.en: Exactly. That's another reason I'm holding out for the PC version.
lines.zh: 没错。这是我等 PC 版的另一个原因。

lines.en: Wait, is it because of mods? I've heard PC players love mods.
lines.zh: 等等，是因为模组吗？听说 PC 玩家很爱模组。

lines.en: Partly. Mods can make a game last for years, and I like tweaking the graphics.
lines.zh: 部分是。模组能让一个游戏玩好几年，而且我喜欢调整画质。

lines.en: Fair enough. Just don't blame me if the wait drives you crazy.
lines.zh: 有道理。不过等得发疯别怪我。

lines.en: Ha, I'll survive. Worst case, I'll watch a few clips in the meantime.
lines.zh: 哈，我能撑住。最坏的情况，我先看几个片段。

lines.en: I'm holding out for the PC version. I'm holding out for a sale before I buy it.
It's coming out on PS5 first. I'll play it on PC. The game is coming out on Xbox first.
lines.zh: 平台前用 on，不说 in PC

lines.en: Are you going to pick it up at launch? Did you pick it up on launch day?
lines.zh: 口语的买下；代词 it 放中间

lines.en: I'd rather wait than buy a console. I'd rather save my money than buy a console.
lines.zh: 宁可……也不……；rather 后不加 to

It's worth waiting for. It's worth the wait. The story is worth playing twice.

title: 每日开口 第07课 · 聊留学选校与给建议

lines.en: So why did you choose an English-taught electrical engineering programme?
lines.zh: 你为什么选了英语授课的电气工程专业？

lines.en: The main reason is the job market. Big cities have a lot of international companies, and most of my internship interviews are in English.
lines.zh: 主要原因是就业市场。大城市有很多国际公司，我大部分实习面试都是英语。

lines.en: Aren't most programmes in Germany taught in German?
lines.zh: 德国大部分专业不是用德语授课吗？

lines.en: Yes, most other universities teach mainly in German. That's why I picked a big city.
lines.zh: 是的，其他大学大多以德语授课。这就是我选大城市的原因。

lines.en: But big cities are expensive, right?
Definitely. Another thing to consider is the rent. It's a lot higher than in smaller cities.
lines.zh: 当然。还要考虑的是房租，比小城市高得多。

lines.en: So is it worth it?
For me, yes. It depends on what you want. If you want an international career, a big city makes sense.
lines.zh: 对我来说值得。这要看你想要什么。想走国际路线，大城市就合理。

lines.en: I've noticed that a lot of people stop studying after their first degree. Why is that?
lines.zh: 我发现很多人读完第一个学位就不继续学了，为什么？

lines.en: I'm no expert, but I think money is part of it. Rent is high, and many people would rather start working.
lines.zh: 我不是专家，但我觉得钱是原因之一。房租高，很多人宁可直接工作。

lines.en: What about you? Do you plan to keep studying?
Maybe. AI has made learning a lot easier, so I can pick things up on the job.
lines.zh: 也许。AI 让学习容易多了，我可以边工作边学。

lines.en: Like what?
When I get stuck on a problem at work, I ask AI to explain it step by step. It helps me figure it out quickly.
lines.zh: 工作中遇到问题卡住时，我让 AI 一步一步解释，能帮我很快想明白。

lines.en: Sounds useful. Have you thought about using it for your German too?
lines.zh: 听起来很有用。你有没有想过也用它练德语？

lines.en: Good idea. With English and German, I'd really stand out.
lines.zh: 好主意。会英语又会德语，我会很突出。

lines.en: By the way, would you recommend a big city to a first-year student?
lines.zh: 顺便问一下，你会向大一新生推荐大城市吗？

lines.en: It depends on their budget. I'd suggest looking at shared flats to keep the rent down.
lines.zh: 要看他们的预算。我建议看看合租，把房租压下来。

lines.en: Good tip. Any last advice for someone choosing a programme?
lines.zh: 好建议。对选专业的人还有最后的建议吗？

lines.en: Check the language of instruction first. Then talk to current students before you decide.
lines.zh: 先确认授课语言。然后在决定之前，和在读的学生聊聊。

lines.en: The main reason is that big cities have international companies. That's why I picked one. The main reason is that the course is taught in English.
lines.zh: 先说原因，再用 That's why 引出结果

lines.en: Another thing to consider is the rent. Another thing to consider is the cost of living.
lines.zh: 补充要考虑的因素，后接名词

lines.en: It's taught in English. Most other universities teach mainly in German. My programme is taught in English.
lines.zh: 授课语言用被动 taught in；不说 teached

lines.en: It depends on what you want. I'm no expert, but I think money is part of it. It depends on your budget. I'm no expert, but I'd say Munich is pricey.
lines.zh: 要看……；谈别人的话题先打预防针

title: 每日开口 第08课 · 职业建议与AI时代的专业

lines.en: You've done a few internships now. What advice would you give someone choosing a career path?
lines.zh: 你已经做过几次实习了。对选职业方向的人，你有什么建议？

lines.en: In my experience, it helps to try things early. My internships showed me what I actually enjoy.
lines.zh: 根据我的经验，早点尝试很有帮助。实习让我知道自己真正喜欢什么。

lines.en: But how do you know which field is safe? A lot of popular majors seem risky now.
lines.zh: 但怎么知道哪个领域安全？很多热门专业现在好像有风险。

lines.en: Fair point. According to some reports, entry-level jobs in certain fields are shrinking because of AI.
lines.zh: 有道理。据一些报告，某些领域的入门岗位因为 AI 在减少。

lines.en: Which ones, for example?
I'm no expert, but routine tasks like basic coding, translation and data entry are being automated.
lines.zh: 我不是专家，但像基础编程、翻译和数据录入这类重复性工作正在被自动化。

lines.en: That's worrying. Does that mean those degrees are worthless?
lines.zh: 这让人担心。这是说这些学位没用了吗？

lines.en: Not necessarily. The data suggests it's getting harder for graduates to find entry-level jobs, but people who use AI well still stand out.
lines.zh: 不一定。数据显示毕业生越来越难找入门工作，但会用 AI 的人依然很突出。

lines.en: So what's your advice?
My advice would be to build skills that AI can't easily replace, like understanding real hardware and solving messy problems.
lines.zh: 我的建议是培养 AI 难以替代的技能，比如理解真实的硬件、解决复杂的问题。

lines.en: Is that why you chose electrical engineering?
lines.zh: 这就是你选电气工程的原因吗？

lines.en: Partly. Instead of competing with AI, I'd rather learn to work with it.
lines.zh: 部分是。与其和 AI 竞争，我宁可学会和它合作。

lines.en: Makes sense. What would you do if your field changed completely?
lines.zh: 有道理。如果你的领域彻底变了，你会怎么办？

lines.en: I'd keep learning. If a skill becomes outdated, I'll pick up the next one.
lines.zh: 我会继续学。如果某项技能过时了，我就学下一个。

lines.en: And what about people who are already stuck in a declining field?
lines.zh: 那已经困在衰退领域里的人呢？

lines.en: If I were you, I'd start with a small project and build from there. Don't wait until it's too late.
lines.zh: 如果我是你，我会从一个小项目开始，再慢慢往上做。别等到太晚。

lines.en: That's good advice. Is there anything you wish you'd known earlier?
lines.zh: 这是好建议。有什么你希望早点知道的吗？

lines.en: Honestly, I wish I'd started applying for internships sooner. Experience matters as much as grades.
lines.zh: 说实话，我希望自己早点开始申请实习。经验和成绩一样重要。

lines.en: And how do you stay up to date with all the changes?
lines.zh: 那你怎么跟上这些变化？

lines.en: I follow a few industry reports and try new tools every month. It keeps me ahead of the curve.
lines.zh: 我关注一些行业报告，每个月试用新工具。这让我保持领先。

lines.en: In my experience, it helps to try things early. My internships showed me what the job is really like.

title: 每日开口 第09课 · 聊消费习惯

lines.en: Be honest, how much do you think you spend each month?
lines.zh: 说实话，你觉得自己每个月花多少钱？

lines.en: More than I'd like, to be honest. Most of it goes on rent and groceries.
lines.zh: 说实话比我希望的多。大部分花在房租和食品上。

lines.en: That's normal in a big city. Do you keep track of your spending?
lines.zh: 大城市里很正常。你有记账吗？

lines.en: I try to. I use an app, but I forget to check it sometimes.
lines.zh: 我在努力。我用一个应用，但有时忘了看。

lines.en: Where does the rest of your money go?
Mostly food and coffee. I tend to spend more when I'm stressed or busy.
lines.zh: 主要是吃的和咖啡。我压力大或忙的时候往往花得更多。

lines.en: Same here. I end up buying things I don't need, especially online.
lines.zh: 我也是。我总会买一些不需要的东西，尤其是网上。

lines.en: Impulse buys are dangerous. One coffee doesn't cost much, but it all adds up.
lines.zh: 冲动消费很危险。一杯咖啡不贵，但积少成多。

lines.en: Exactly. I'm trying to cut back on eating out.
lines.zh: 没错。我在努力少外出就餐。

lines.en: How's that going?
Not great. Cooking takes time, and some days I'm too tired.
lines.zh: 不太好。做饭费时间，有些天我太累了。

lines.en: Maybe try cooking in bigger batches. Then you'll have lunch ready for the whole week.
lines.zh: 也许试试一次多做几份。这样一整周的午饭都有了。

lines.en: Good idea. Do you stick to a budget?
More or less. I set a limit for fun money, and when it's gone, it's gone.
lines.zh: 差不多吧。我给娱乐花销设了上限，花完就没了。

lines.en: What about second-hand stuff? Is it worth it?
lines.zh: 二手的东西呢？值得买吗？

lines.en: For things like furniture or books, definitely. I can't afford to buy everything new.
lines.zh: 家具或书这类绝对值得。我负担不起全买新的。

lines.en: And subscriptions? I feel like I'm paying for five apps I never use.
lines.zh: 订阅呢？我感觉自己在为五个从不用的应用付费。

lines.en: Check them every few months. If you haven't used one for weeks, cancel it.
lines.zh: 每隔几个月检查一下。如果几周没用，就取消。

lines.en: Do you think students spend differently from people with full-time jobs?
lines.zh: 你觉得学生和全职工作的人花钱方式不一样吗？

lines.en: I'm no expert, but I think students are more careful, because every euro counts.
lines.zh: 我不是专家，但我觉得学生更谨慎，因为每一欧元都很重要。

lines.en: True. Although I spend more on food than I admit.
lines.zh: 是的。不过我在吃上花的比我承认的多。

lines.en: Me too. Let's both track our spending for a month and compare.
lines.zh: 我也是。我们都记一个月的账，然后比比。

lines.en: Deal. Whoever spends more buys the coffee.
lines.zh: 成交。花得多的人请喝咖啡。

lines.en: Ha, that's a risky bet for both of us.
lines.zh: 哈，这对我们俩都是个有风险的赌。

lines.en: I tend to spend more when I'm stressed. I tend to buy things online at night.
lines.zh: 说自己的习惯倾向，意思是往往会；tend to 后接原形

title: 每日开口 第10课 · 聊短视频与剧透

lines.en: Have you seen that new sci-fi film everyone's talking about?
lines.zh: 你看了大家都在聊的那部新科幻片吗？

lines.en: Not the whole thing. I came across a clip on Douyin, and it looked amazing.
lines.zh: 没看完整部。我在抖音上刷到一个片段，看起来很棒。

lines.en: Oh, which scene?
The big chase scene near the end. Honestly, that clip is the best part of the whole film.
lines.zh: 临近结尾的大追逐戏。说实话，那个片段是整部电影最精彩的部分。

lines.en: How do you know? You just said you haven't seen it.
lines.zh: 你怎么知道？你刚说没看过。

lines.en: Because I watched a few reviews. They all say the rest is pretty boring.
lines.zh: 因为我看了几个影评。都说其余部分挺无聊的。

lines.en: Wait, so the clip is basically the highlight?
lines.zh: 等等，所以那个片段基本就是高光？

lines.en: Yes. It's edited so well that it makes the whole film look incredible.
lines.zh: 对。剪辑得太好了，让整部电影看起来很了不起。

lines.en: That's clever marketing, though. They show the best bits and hide the rest.
lines.zh: 不过这是聪明的营销。只放最好的部分，藏起其余的。

lines.en: True. I'd say it's not worth watching the whole thing just for one scene.
lines.zh: 没错。我觉得不值得为了一场戏看完整部。

lines.en: Then why did you send it to everyone in the group chat?
lines.zh: 那你为什么发给群里所有人？

lines.en: Because it's fun to share! But I hope I didn't spoil it for anyone.
lines.zh: 因为分享很有趣！但我希望没有给任何人剧透。

lines.en: Well, you did. I haven't seen it, and now I know how the chase ends.
lines.zh: 你剧透了。我还没看，现在我知道追逐戏怎么结束了。

lines.en: Sorry! I should have said "spoiler alert" first.
lines.zh: 抱歉！我应该先说一声“剧透警告”。

lines.en: It's fine. Honestly, a film with only one good scene doesn't sound worth my time.
lines.zh: 没事。说实话，只有一场好戏的电影听起来不值得我花时间。

lines.en: Maybe. Some people like to see the whole story, though.
lines.zh: 也许。不过有些人喜欢看完整的故事。

lines.en: What about the acting? Is that good?
I'm no expert, but from what I've heard, the acting is decent.
lines.zh: 我不是专家，但据我所知，演技还不错。

lines.en: So would you recommend it?
Only if you're bored on a rainy weekend. Otherwise, just watch the clip.
lines.zh: 除非下雨的周末你很无聊。否则看片段就行。

lines.en: Funny, you're telling me to skip the film and just watch the clip.
lines.zh: 有意思，你让我跳过电影，只看片段。

lines.en: Well, short videos have changed how I watch things. I'd rather watch ten great minutes than two boring hours.
lines.zh: 短视频改变了我看东西的方式。我宁可看十分钟精彩的，也不看两小时无聊的。

lines.en: Same. But the editing is a kind of skill too.
lines.zh: 我也是。但剪辑也是一种技能。

lines.en: Absolutely. Good editors can make an average film look like a masterpiece.
lines.zh: 当然。好的剪辑师能让一部普通的电影看起来像杰作。

lines.en: Is the story any good, though? I mean the narrative, not just the scenes.
lines.zh: 不过故事本身好吗？我是说叙事，不只是几场戏。

lines.en: Hard to say. One great scene doesn't make a good narrative.
lines.zh: 很难说。一场精彩的戏不等于好的叙事。

lines.en: Right. A clip shows only one scene, so you miss how the story is built.
lines.zh: 对。片段只展示一场戏，所以你看不到故事是怎么搭起来的。

lines.en: Exactly. If the narrative is strong, the whole film is worth watching. If not, the clip is enough.
lines.zh: 没错。如果叙事有力，整部电影就值得看；如果没有，看片段就够了。

lines.en: I hope I didn't spoil it for anyone. Please don't give away the ending.
lines.zh: 剧透；不说 spoil it out；名词 spoiler，提醒用 spoiler alert

title: 每日开口 第11课 · 聊AI工具与换软件

lines.en: Which AI tool are you using these days?
lines.zh: 你最近在用哪个 AI 工具？

lines.en: Mostly Claude, but I've been trying Gemini recently. It's really fast.
lines.zh: 主要是 Claude，但最近在试 Gemini。它真的很快。

lines.en: Weren't you using GPT a while ago?
lines.zh: 你不是不久前还在用 GPT 吗？

lines.en: I was. I cancelled my subscription and switched to Claude.
lines.zh: 是的。我退订了，换成了 Claude。

lines.en: What made you switch?
Honestly, I just wanted to try something different, and I ended up liking it.
lines.zh: 说实话，我只是想试试不一样的，结果挺喜欢的。

lines.en: And now Gemini?
Yes. It brings so many features together, so it does more in one place.
lines.zh: 对。它把很多功能整合在一起，所以一个地方能做更多事。

lines.en: That sounds convenient.
It is, but moving from one app to another is a hassle. It takes time to get used to a new interface.
lines.zh: 是方便，但从一个软件换到另一个很麻烦。适应新界面要花时间。

lines.en: I know that feeling. Your habits, your prompts, everything has to change.
lines.zh: 我懂那种感觉。习惯、提示词，一切都得变。

lines.en: Exactly. I had to rebuild my whole workflow.
lines.zh: 没错。我得重建整个工作流程。

lines.en: So have you completely stopped using GPT?
lines.zh: 那你完全不用 GPT 了吗？

lines.en: Almost. I barely open it anymore.
lines.zh: 几乎是。我几乎不再打开它了。

lines.en: Do you think you'll go back?
Who knows? I might switch back one day if it gets much better.
lines.zh: 谁知道呢？如果它进步很多，我也许哪天会换回来。

lines.en: Ha, you never know.
Right. These tools change so fast that the best one today might not be the best next month.
lines.zh: 对。这些工具变化太快，今天最好的下个月不一定还是。

lines.en: So how do you decide which one to use?
It depends on what I'm doing. For some tasks one tool is better, for others another.
lines.zh: 要看我在做什么。有些任务这个更好，有些任务那个更好。

lines.en: Isn't that too many tabs?
lines.zh: 那不是开太多标签页了吗？

lines.en: A bit, but I'd rather have the right tool for each job than force one tool to do everything.
lines.zh: 有点，但我宁可每项工作用合适的工具，也不想让一个工具包办一切。

lines.en: Fair. Do you pay for all of them?
No way. I only pay for one, and I stick with it unless something is clearly better.
lines.zh: 怎么可能。我只为一个付费，除非有明显更好的，否则就一直用它。

lines.zh: 换用；退订说 cancel my subscription

title: 每日开口 第12课 · 冰沙与抗炎减肥

lines.en: Hey, you look different. Have you lost weight?
lines.zh: 嘿，你看起来不一样了，是瘦了吗？

lines.en: A little. I've been trying to cut down on sugar since September.
lines.zh: 一点点。我从九月开始努力少吃糖。

lines.en: Really? What changed?
Instead of buying juice, I make a smoothie every morning.
lines.zh: 我不再买果汁，而是每天早上打一杯冰沙。

lines.en: Isn't that just sugar in a cup?
Not if you do it right. Mine is packed with spinach, berries and ginger.
lines.zh: 做对了就不是。我的里面满是菠菜、莓果和姜。

lines.en: Ginger? Why ginger?
It helps reduce inflammation. My knee used to hurt after running.
lines.zh: 它有助于抗炎。我以前跑步后膝盖会疼。

lines.en: And does it actually work?
I think so. I've noticed a difference since I started drinking it.
lines.zh: 我觉得有。从开始喝以来，我感觉有变化。

lines.en: What else goes in it?
Greek yoghurt, a spoonful of oats and some chia seeds.
lines.zh: 希腊酸奶、一勺燕麦和一些奇亚籽。

lines.en: Doesn't that make it too heavy?
No, it keeps me full until lunch, so I don't snack.
lines.zh: 不会，它能让我撑到午饭，所以我不吃零食。

lines.en: That's the hard part for me. I always end up grabbing biscuits.
lines.zh: 这正是我的难点。我总是忍不住抓饼干吃。

lines.en: Make sure you add some protein. That's what stops the cravings.
lines.zh: 一定要加点蛋白质，它能压住嘴馋。

lines.en: What about fruit? Is banana okay?
Sure, as long as you don't use more than half a banana.
lines.zh: 当然，只要别超过半根香蕉。

lines.en: Good to know. I'd swap my morning croissant for a smoothie.
lines.zh: 好的，我可以把早上的可颂换成冰沙。

lines.en: Try it for two weeks. It's easy to blend it up before work.
lines.zh: 试两周吧。上班前打一杯很简单。

lines.en: Okay, I'll give it a go. Can you send me your recipe?
lines.zh: 好，我试试。能把你的配方发我吗？

lines.en: Of course. And don't forget: it's not a magic fix, you still need to move.
lines.zh: 当然。别忘了，它不是灵丹妙药，你还得运动。

lines.en: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
lines.zh: 少吃/少做；on 不能丢，别说 cut down sugar。

lines.en: This smoothie is packed with fibre.
